name: Z-Cars
description: Z-Cars or Z Cars is a British television drama series centred on the work of mobile uniformed police in the fictional town of Newtown, based on Kirkby, Merseyside. Produced by the BBC, it debuted in January 1962 and ran until September 1978.

videos.title: Four of a Kind
videos.overview: The search is on for four young men to ""crew"" the new cars in the tough and troubled district of Newtown, a North of England overspill estate. A mixed community, displaced from the larger towns by slum clearance, has been brought together and housed on an estate without amenities.

videos.title: The Limping Rabbit
videos.overview: A girl disappears, and Steele and Lynch are faced by a conspiracy of silence in her broken family.

videos.title: Handle With Care
videos.overview: An explosion in a quarry disturbs two lovers. It also disturbs Detective Sergeant John Watt when he finds out what caused it.

videos.title: Stab In The Dark
videos.overview: A wounding case brings top brass into Victor Division to investigate.  Lynch and Steele work overtime to find the villain.

videos.title: Big Catch
videos.overview: When the whalers hit Seaport after a good season Smith and Weir have their work cut out to keep trouble to a minimum.

videos.title: Friday Night
videos.overview: ""It's going to be one of those nights"", pronounced Sgt. Percy Twentyman, and he wasn't far wrong.  Steele and Lynch have to cope with the aftermath of a traffic accident in which a drunken driver has killed a motor cyclist and his pillion passenger.  Small time felon Grandpa Maddigan blows up the safe in the Gas Company office, Watt and DCS Robins are hot on the trail of the notorious Comber gang, and Twentyman himself gets more than he bargained for when he tries to break up a free-for-all in the Tabernacle pub.

videos.title: Suspended
videos.overview: The crew of Z-Victor One waste no time in arriving at the scene of a burglary.  Their reward is to be suspected of theft themselves.

videos.title: Family Feud
videos.overview: When two feuding families go to war Lynch and Steele find themselves in the front line.

videos.title: Fire!
videos.overview: The report of a burning barn takes Smith and Weir into the country, searching for a fire-raiser.

videos.title: Threats And Menaces
videos.overview: In Victor Division the police often live next door to unruly members of the community.  Bob and Janey Steele find that this can have unpleasant, even dangerous, consequences.

videos.title: Jail Break
videos.overview: What is a mysterious stranger from Soho doing in Victor Division?  John Watt would like to know, and keeps a close watch on him.  Smith and Weir are heavily involved in the tracking down of money previously stolen in a mailbag robbery.  Both events are triggered by a successful jail break.

videos.title: What Kind Of Hero?
videos.overview: A young man risks his life to save that of an accident victim trapped under an overturned road tanker, then disappears quietly.  One of the bystanders, a retired army officer, pesters Barlow to trace the man and see that he gets the recognition he deserves.  Barlow eventually finds the reluctant hero, only to discover that he is an army deserter wanted by the Military Police!

videos.title: Sudden Death
videos.overview: When a case of murder is reported Lynch and Steele are the first policemen on the scene.  But the main responsibility for organising the hunt for the killer falls on Barlow, whose toughness is backed by vast experience and an intuitive mind.

videos.title: Found Abandoned
videos.overview: Smith and Weir answer a call and find an abandoned baby.  They bring it along to the station, where Inspector Dunn is in charge in Barlow's absence.

videos.title: The Best Days
videos.overview: Lynch and Steele have their hands full when a gang of boys break into a school and smash up the headmaster's study.  But the hooliganism doesn't stop there.  When they are disturbed by the caretaker the oldest member of the gang attacks him and leaves him seriously injured.

videos.title: Invisible Enemy
videos.overview: When a gas meter is broken into in a big block of flats Weir and Smith think their hunt is only for a petty thief.  What they encounter, though, is someone much more dangerous.

videos.title: Down And Out
videos.overview: A drunk causes a disturbance, two thieves break into a pet shop - and Steele and Lynch end the night at knife-point.

videos.title: Further Enquiries
videos.overview: Weir stops a car driving without lights, the first event in a night which brings 'important' people in the county to Newtown police station.

videos.title: Winner Takes All
videos.overview: A race track tout forgets to pay his alimony, and Steele and Lynch discover an ingenious fraud to beat the bookies.

videos.title: People's Property
videos.overview: It's a busy night for Smith, Weir and Sergeant Watt when burglary is rife.

videos.title: Hi-Jack!
videos.overview: At Pete's Caff Steele and Lynch report ""off watch for refreshments"".  While they are eating and talking to Steele's friend Les Fielding his lorry is hi-jacked.

videos.title: Incident Reported
videos.overview: Fancy Smith first meets Stan Carron in the Tabernacle pub where Carron is causing a disturbance.  They have an argument.  The second time they meet Carron is in no state to argue and Smith starts a long night's work.

videos.title: Never On Wednesday
videos.overview: For two years Barlow has been trying to catch a Newtown thief.  When DCS Robins takes a personal interest the pressure is on for everyone - particularly Steele and Lynch.

videos.title: Day Trip
videos.overview: A charabanc outing, a halt at a pub and an exponent of the three-card trick: this is how a day at the seaside begins.  It ends in violence.

videos.title: Affray
videos.overview: Two men claim the same prize and trouble begins.  When Lynch and Steele are called there is an unexpected development and a policeman dies.

videos.title: Contraband
videos.overview: The prospect of a 'finder's reward' in a dockland smuggling case makes Smith and Weir eager volunteers for extra duty.

videos.title: Teamwork
videos.overview: Just when the crime figures are levelling out one man pushes them up and up with a series of aimless break-ins.  When Steele and Lynch lay hands on him but let him escape Barlow, Watt and Dunn are ready to lay hands on them!

videos.title: Appearance In Court
videos.overview: Catching a thief is only the beginning as far as the police are concerned.  When Smith and Weir have to justify their action in court the truth is made to look slightly less than the whole truth.

videos.title: Assault
videos.overview: Barlow is investigating a case of assault.  Betty Ancoats accuses four youths of attacking her, but one of them, Hogan, who has a reputation for violence, denies any knowledge of the crime.

videos.title: Unconditional Surrender
videos.overview: Barlow initiates a campaign against the Cruddock brothers and their gang.  The Z-Cars engage in 'Operation Harassment' and a state of total war develops.

videos.title: On Watch - Newtown
videos.overview: Both crews are forced to realise the narrow margin between life and death on a busy night in which Barlow and Twentyman miss one crime and catch two criminals.

videos.title: Full Remission
videos.overview: A pretty girl out alone and late at night leads Steele and Lynch to a robbery and to a tearaway more dangerous than any they have encountered before.

videos.title: Truth Or Dare
videos.overview: The violent death of a small shopkeeper brings Supt. Miller into Victor Division and into conflict with Barlow, who has his own solution to offer.

videos.title: Information Received
videos.overview: Z-Victor Two gets an alarm call to a jeweller's shop.  Sgt. Watt gets the information that leads to an arrest, but the case is not as simple as it seems.

videos.title: Friendly Relations
videos.overview: The trail of a walk-in thief leads Smith and Weir to a locked room in Newtown and on to a night in Blackpool - but not to see the illuminations!

videos.title: Corroboration
videos.overview: Lynch and Steele investigate a break-in at a factory where the night watchman has been attacked and injured.  They bring in a man the Newtown police have long wanted to see behind bars.  But bringing him in is one thing, keeping him in is another.

videos.title: The Thin Girl
videos.overview: A neat operation in car stealing begins to go wrong when the thief tries mixing business with pleasure.

videos.title: Johnny Sailor
videos.overview: Johnny attacks a man in a pub - the wrong man.  Steele and Lynch have to find him before he finds the right man.

videos.title: Person Unknown
videos.overview: Detective Superintendent Miller, aggressive as ever, leads the local Newtown force as they attempt to find a man who has attacked several young girls.

videos.title: Ambush
videos.overview: Dick Davis comes out of Walton jail and immediately plans his first job.  But after two years in prison Davis cannot match the quality of his planning with the quality of his new accomplices.

videos.title: Known To The Police
videos.overview: Hilda Simmons reports that her car has been stolen.  But she omits to tell the police that the man who took it is her husband.  Smith and Weir have the task of rounding up the 'thief' only to find that the charge has been withdrawn.  However, Sgt. Watt recognises Simmons of old, and soon tumbles to what is happening.

videos.title: The Navigators
videos.overview: Lynch and Steele are called to a pub fight.  Who started it?  As Geraghty said: ""Hollis is always starting fights.  Too clever for himself this time, though - far too clever"".

videos.title: Business Trip
videos.overview: A London gang move north.  They plan a short and profitable visit to Newtown.  Smith and Weir spend a busy night trying to cut down their profits and lengthen their stay.

videos.title: Five Whistles
videos.overview: A quantity of drink and five suits are missing.  Steele and Lynch spend a long night looking for the drink while the rest of the Newtown police are at the Christmas party.

videos.title: Search
videos.overview: When a child is reported missing on Christmas Day Smith and Weir are first in what becomes a countrywide hunt for him.  They search all day and into the night in a desperate attempt to find him.

videos.title: All Up By Seven
videos.overview: Arrest usually pile up at night - except in this case that involves a safe, the Army, a divorce and a potted plant.

videos.title: Trumpet Voluntary
videos.overview: Eddie plays the trumpet badly and on the streets, so his contacts with the police are frequent.  This time, however, there is more than music involved.

videos.title: Five And A Match
videos.overview: Export cigarettes are being imported into the Newtown area.  Lynch and Steele pick up some fag-ends of information.

videos.title: The Hitch-Hiker
videos.overview: A casual lift as the rain pours down - and for Winnie Parker it means a drive of terror.  Her kindness in persuading her husband to pick up a hitch-hiker puts her in danger and gives a long night of anxiety and work for Smith and Weir.

videos.title: A Simple Case
videos.overview: Bob Steele is late for work.  And because of this he becomes accidentally involved in a case concerning a petty thief.  He is going through the town's shopping centre when a middle-aged woman comes running out of one of the stores, closely pursued by a security guard.  She has apparently been shoplifting.  But what seems at first sight to be a 'simple case' confronts Steele with the biggest decision of his life.   (This was Jeremy Kemp's last appearance as PC Bob Steele.)

videos.title: Act Of Vengeance
videos.overview: The act is sudden, brutal and corroding.  The problem facing Barlow is what the victim has done to warrant it.

videos.title: The Listeners
videos.overview: Lynch goes out on patrol with PC Dave Graham, the former dog-handler who has been chosen to replace Bob Steele.  With Lynch missing the companionship of Steele, the relationship between the new pair is not easy.  They quickly run into trouble - with each other and with a pair of thieves with an ear to police business.

videos.title: The Main Chance
videos.overview: Cock-fighting is cruel, bloody and illegal.  Its promoters have to work in secret, and so do the police in trying to catch the perpetrators.

videos.title: Follow My Leader
videos.overview: The trail of counterfeit notes begins in a chemist's shop.  Following it is more complicated than Lynch and Graham would ever have believed.

videos.title: Members Only
videos.overview: The men want the new club to be peaceful and palatial.  John Watt's concern is with the way it is being financed and furnished.

videos.title: Matter Of Conviction
videos.overview: A serious crime has to be reported to Headquarters.  Barlow's main worry is that the crime may not have been committed at all.

videos.title: The Bad Lad
videos.overview: In an attempt to improve the crime statistics Barlow has Smith and Weir devoting valuable time to the theft of a bicycle lamp and John Watt is set to clear up an affair of lead castings pilfered from a factory.  Both seem trivial, but Barlow thinks that they are worth some trouble - and as usual he is proved right in the end.

videos.title: Enquiry
videos.overview: Despite all the anger and resentment they arouse nothing must deflect Inspector Bamber from the most difficult enquiries of his career - into suspicions that Victor Division contains a policeman who is a thief.

videos.title: Pay By Results
videos.overview: Glossop is a name all too familiar to Newtown CID.  His record includes larceny, assault, shopbreaking, gaming and assault on police.  So when he escapes from prison and is reported to be back in Newtown Barlow makes it his personal business to find him.  But knowing Glossop's reputation, the informers are reluctant to talk.

videos.title: The Peterman
videos.overview: A big bump in the night and the hunt for the safebreakers is on.  But the safebreakers are hunting too - for the expert.

videos.title: The Birds Of The Air
videos.overview: Only when the birds have flown does Z-Victor One get called to the Atlantic Hotel, where a man and woman are wanted for not paying their bill.  Barlow has to set snares to catch them.

videos.title: Train Of Events
videos.overview: A mailbag robbery in Newtown and Barlow is in his element as the masterly organiser at the centre of operations.  He sends Lynch and Graham to set up a road block, chivvies John Watt into scouting for information and reminds Sgt. Blackitt of the golden rule: ""Can't afford to let things stop or get bogged down"".

videos.title: By The Book
videos.overview: ""Crimes like this, there's always two, always.  I've never known it otherwise"".  And DCS Robins is talking about murder.

videos.title: Nothing Serious
videos.overview: A vicious bunch of thugs and a young couple in love.  Lynch and Graham are involved with both while their own working relationship reaches flash point.  PC Sweet and the relative newcomer DC Hicks also get caught up in the action.

videos.title: Alarm Call
videos.overview: The alarm rings and the police dash to the scene.  This is the reflex action a clever crook can calculate on - except when PC Jock Weir decides to take charge.

videos.title: A Try By Weir
videos.overview: It's the night after a big rugby football match.  Lynch and Graham get a surprise when they are sent to investigate a spot of trouble at a pub on the Newtown to Seaport road, for there they find Jock Weir.  He is having a drink with friends to celebrate playing on the winning side, but with the arrival of Lynch and Graham the evening turns out to be anything but a happy one.

videos.title: Quiet Confidence
videos.overview: Fancy Smith's devotion to duty takes him, on his night off, to visit a young offender's father, with results that make him bitterly and furiously angry.

videos.title: Scare
videos.overview: The crew of a merchant ship about to dock at Seaport are looking forward to shore leave.  They have money to burn and an itch to burn it in Rosie's Club.  When a smallpox scare leads to all leave being stopped, two sailors have other ideas and sneak ashore.  Lynch and Graham have to find them to prevent a possible smallpox epidemic.

videos.title: Caught By The Ears
videos.overview: Cattle are identified by marks on their ears.  Sgt. Watt and Z-Victor One have to find their own way of identifying the people responsible for a large-scale fraud.

videos.title: Come On The Lads
videos.overview: In soccer mad Newtown tickets for the big match are at a premium.  Everyone wants to go, villains and police alike.  Con man Johnson has eight tickets to distribute to people who might be useful to him, but mistakenly hands them to Paddy, a fixer who has his own ideas about who to give them to.  Lynch and Graham also have tickets and are on their way to the stadium when they come into violent contact with a gang of men in a stolen lorry.

videos.title: The Whizzers
videos.overview: A team of pickpockets and the attempt to track them down leads Jock Weir into serious trouble with the public and with the Chief Constable.

videos.title: Police Work
videos.overview: The Coroner's demand for the presence of a witness sends Smith and Weir to a lonely cottage, to be greeted with a kind of violence even they do not expect.

videos.title: Lucky Accident
videos.overview: An attempted burglary and a hit-and-run accident - PC Lynch sees the connection first.  Proving it is a job for the whole of Victor Division.

videos.title: Made For Each Other
videos.overview: Two arrests, two court cases - and also two people, in one of whom Fancy Smith takes a personal interest.

videos.title: A La Carte
videos.overview: Chief Inspector Barlow is known locally as something of a gourmet, but not even the chef believes that he is interested only in food.

videos.title: Light The Blue Paper
videos.overview: The bang is loud in the night.  The conspiracy of silence which follows is more sinister.  When an explosion destroys Bill Webster's betting shop CID runs up against a blank wall.  No clues and there is nobody willing to talk.  Webster himself stubbornly maintains it was an accident, but Barlow is convinced there is a connection between the explosion and the fact that Webster intends to compete with his rivals by opening more shops in the area.

videos.title: A Quiet Night
videos.overview: PCs Lynch and Graham find that a quiet night can be just as busy as any other, but for some of the people they encounter it is also a night of tragedy.

videos.title: Hit And Run
videos.overview: A slight collision between two cars, a bad-tempered blow, and a young man finds himself involved in serious trouble - both for himself and for those close to him.

videos.title: Hide - And Go Seek
videos.overview: A young rookie constable cannot hold his liquor.  In his cups he reveals the whereabouts of a 'safe house' holding a vital witness, with disastrous consequences.

videos.title: The Kiter
videos.overview: An outbreak of thefts from offertory boxes, a flood of dud cheques - and Victor Division's crime figures begin to soar.  Barlow and Watt try to identify a petty criminal with an interest in churches.

videos.title: Special Duty
videos.overview: Lynch and Graham investigate a domestic tragedy.  And for Barlow there's the urgent problem of saving a man's life.

videos.title: Remembrance Of A Guest
videos.overview: Complaints about a fast-moving, fast-talking door-to-door salesman give Weir and Smith a busy day, while Sgt. Watt prepares the trap.

videos.title: Daylight Robbery
videos.overview: When a Newtown pillar box begins to belch smoke Graham's first reaction is that someone has been posting red hot love letters.  But by the time thirteen pillar boxes have been burned out he and Lynch are on the trail of an unusual kind of pyromaniac.  Meanwhile Sgt. Watt is keeping an eye on Oliver Snow, a visitor from London who goes out of his way to be offensive.

videos.title: Running Milligan
videos.overview: Freddy Milligan is servinga  prison sentence for robbery with violence. With six weeks of his sentence to run, he is given compassionate parole to attend his wife's funeral. He fails to report back, and the Newtown police get the job of bringing him in.

videos.title: Choose Your Partners
videos.overview: A report of breaking and entering at Mallory Hall and soon Lord Tenterden's home is swarming with policemen from the ACC right down to Fancy Smith.  The thieves have taken something far more valuable than the money they were after.  Is espionage involved?

videos.title: Tuesday Afternoon
videos.overview: A case of shoplifting, the disappearance of 3,000 bricks and some unbuilt houses give Barlow and the boys in Z-Victor One a busy day.

videos.title: Supper In The Morning
videos.overview: Dave Graham is used to sorting out the problems of other people, but only as a policeman.  He finds it much more difficult to cope with a crisis in his own home.

videos.title: Wait For It
videos.overview: Some crimes are solved by logic.  Barlow finds one but Smith and Weir look like upsetting him in their persistent search for a stolen purse.

videos.title: It Never Rains ...
videos.overview: On Christmas Eve Lynch and Graham are as full of goodwill to all men as any police officers can be - with a garage robbery to deal with and other people's celebrations getting in the way.

videos.title: .. And A Happy New Year
videos.overview: The revelry of New Year's Eve has its normal problems for the Newtown police and its special opportunities for a lone marauder in the streets.  Sgt. Blackitt, leaving PC Sweet on the desk, is on the beat himself for a change.  Down by the canal is a nurse from the Cottage Hospital and she is out on a cold night without a cloak over her uniform.

videos.title: Happy-Go-Lucky
videos.overview: When a happy-go-lucky thief refuses to confess to a simple breaking and entering job Barlow continues enquiries.  This starts an avalanche of evidence and soon Barlow fears that everyone in Newtown is implicated somewhere along the line.

videos.title: Promise Made
videos.overview: It can't possibly be blackmail - the old lady seems much too innocent and can have nothing to hide.  But Lynch and Graham are sure that something has happened and Barlow decides to set a trap.

videos.title: I Mean...Where Does It Stop?
videos.overview: Weir finds that being a policeman doesn't stop when he goes off duty, particularly as his girl friend Sally has shady connections.

videos.title: A Stroll Along The Sands
videos.overview: A chance encounter is soon forgotten by Lynch and Graham.  But remembering a face becomes vital when Barlow orders a search for missing money - and a missing man.

videos.title: No Malice
videos.overview: Barlow loses a case against a known criminal.  He believes the man is guilty but he is ordered to re-investigate the crime and finds a problem he doesn't want to face.

videos.title: Profit By Their Example
videos.overview: A mysterious meeting at a sports pavilion attracts the attention of Z-Victor Two.  John Watt investigates.  When a sharp warning to a friend is unheeded Watt finds himself at the centre of hostilities.

videos.title: A Question Of Storage
videos.overview: Barlow's attendance at a police conference starts a spring cleaning at Newtown station.  But the arrest of an elderly drunk by Smith and Weir upsets the efficiency drive.

videos.title: Fun And Games
videos.overview: When a seemingly harmless practical joke goes wrong and leads to a disturbance Lynch finds himself involved in a very personal problem.

videos.title: A Man...Like Yourself
videos.overview: When a young offender escapes from custody he is seen hiding on a roof and DC Hicks is detailed to bring him down.

videos.title: A Straight Deal
videos.overview: When Josh Tansfield tries to make a deal with the police John Watt is worried - but Barlow gets the best of a good bargain.

videos.title: Happy Families
videos.overview: A mother finds her schoolboy son in possession of pornographic photographs.  Then the lad goes missing and Smith and weir have the job of finding him.  Meantime Barlow tracks down the source of the photographs.  John Watt deals with his marital problems.  JOSS ACKLAND appears here as the villain: four years later he became a cast regular as DI Todd.

videos.title: Inside Job
videos.overview: A mail van raid - a quick getaway - and no description of the raiders.  When an easy arrest is made Barlow finds a new angle on the 'inside job'.

videos.title: Clues Are What You Think
videos.overview: The search area is wide and time is short - for Barlow is in charge of a murder enquiry for the first time.  He places his faith in two seemingly harmless questions.

videos.title: The Whole Truth...
videos.overview: 'Punchy' Palmer is not too bright.  When he tries to help Newtown police it isn't easy to know what is truth and what is daydreams.  In this guesswork lies the answer to a series of crimes.

videos.title: Whistle, And Come Home
videos.overview: Two children are the only witnesses of a robbery.  It seems that the men concerned will get away with it - until Barlow takes over.

videos.title: First-Class Citizen
videos.overview: Old Eli Mosscrop was once the best spiderman in the north.  Now no-one will employ him.  When he tries to show his skill he makes a problem for John Watt, who has no head for heights.

videos.title: Seconds Away
videos.overview: It is a routine job - a break-in at a jeweller's shop.  But Barlow believes the owner is in danger.

videos.title: Centre Of Disturbance
videos.overview: A brutal mid-afternoon shooting in the middle of a shopping area leaves a store full of people dumbfounded and the Newtown police force shaking its head in disbelief.

videos.title: You Get All Kinds
videos.overview: A baby is taken from a pram near a bingo hall.  Graham and Lynch are involved in a long search.

videos.title: Happy Birthday
videos.overview: A wrist-watch and a camera.  Not unusual gifts for a twenty-first birthday, but they make a busy Saturday for Smith and Weir and upset a wedding.

videos.title: Somebody ... Help
videos.overview: Frank Wood is a homosexual, unable to go to the police when a man sets out to blackmail him.  If he does go to the police he faces trial, possible conviction, even prison, not to mention local scandal and the end of his business career.

videos.title: Cage Until Tame
videos.overview: Arty Timmins is out of jail.  Chief Supt. Robins put him away when he was an Inspector and Sgt. Blackitt was a constable.  With Barlow away on a course Robins makes it his personal business to keep a close watch on one of the hardest characters ever to cross his path.  For there are three citizens of Newtown who, even after ten years, have good cause to be frightened.

videos.title: Family Reunion
videos.overview: When Danny Sullivan, boisterous and irresponsible, returns to Newtown Z-Victor Two is alerted.  When he goes into the used car business there is trouble.

videos.title: A Place Of Safety
videos.overview: Smith and Weir are called to a disturbance in a tenement block.  An unemployed black man has attacked a bailiff with an axe, then barricaded himself in his flat with his wife and children.  Barlow is called and eventually persuades the man to come out, whereupon he is promptly arrested.  It looks like an open and shut case of attempted murder, but Barlow is not satisfied.  Later that evening Smith and Weir find the man's wife and children sleeping in a bus shelter: they have been evicted without notice.

videos.title: The Dark Side Of The Road
videos.overview: Outside in the dark a girl screams.  Inside the tall flats she is heard and ignored.  It is half an hour before one man puts out a reluctant hand to dial 999.

videos.title: What A Main Event!
videos.overview: Two men in a parked car - and the beginning of a night Lynch and Graham will talk about all their lives.  The eventual haul is so good it even induces Barlow to stand drinks for the duo.

videos.title: Finders Keepers
videos.overview: The grimy cafe down by the docks is keeping pretty busy as usual.  The juke-box is giving out the latest sounds of the Mersey Beat at full volume; the youngsters are sitting around drinking strong tea out of thick mugs.  But there is one customer at McKinley's who doesn't seem to fit in.  That is Brayne, the old tramp.  He has no money for tea, but he is wearing an expensive overcoat and a business gent's bowler hat.  Smith and Weir get really involved when they try to find the reason.

videos.title: Lucky Partners
videos.overview: To the young Mrs. Napier the man at the door seems anything but sinister, just buying old gold.  But his method of purchase leaves something to be desired.

videos.title: Soft Spot
videos.overview: Alby Rafferty, an over-zealous car enthusiast, is not past redemption according to John Watt.  But Watt is not the only influence in Alby's life.  So when Mr. Cull's shiny new white car is driven off from under his nose, it is not for use in a robbery - just Alby indulging his passion.

videos.title: Charity Begins ...
videos.overview: ""What's all the fuss about then?"" asks Fancy Smith when he and Jock Weir are called to a case of shoplifting.  ""Cause maybe there's something else too,"" replies Jock.  And as the men of Z-Victor One discover, something else, something much more sinister, there most certainly is.

videos.title: The Hunch
videos.overview: A passing car and a radio message lead Graham and Baker to a particular club with interesting results.  DC Lynch, meanwhile, has the job of finding the leader of a gang specialising in quick break-ins and small but profitable hauls of liquor and cigarettes.  It is his most important case yet and he pins his hopes on a hunch that takes him to London.

videos.title: Two In The Bush
videos.overview: Two crimes - same place, same time - and Smith and weir are ready and able to deal with them.

videos.title: Welcome Home, Jigger
videos.overview: Sgt. Blackitt sets off to give a first aid demonstration at a youth club where trouble is in the air.  Jigger Daniels, released from Borstal, is back in town and has a few old scores to settle.  Meanwhile Lynch has his own problems.  Someone is going around Newtown stealing transistor radios from parked cars, and Barlow is in one of his 'leave no stone unturned' moods.

videos.title: In A Day's Work
videos.overview: A friendly call on a neighbour turns into a sudden nightmare for a young housewife.  She dials 999.  Fancy Smith, alone in Z-Victor One, is sent to investigate and finds himself in a situation that would tax the patience of a priest and a psychologist combined.

videos.title: No Stone Unturned
videos.overview: A sudden death in Newtown brings the new man, Detective Superintendent Prentiss, from Headquarters.  And before the investigation is closed he makes his presence very much felt.

videos.title: You Pays Your Money
videos.overview: When the only witnesses disagree Sergeant Watt settles for the most likely suspect - with surprising results.

videos.title: One Day In Spring Street
videos.overview: Investigating a reported disturbance, Dave Graham finds it is one more skirmish in a running war fought with stones between the boys of a local school and old Lewis, an eccentric character who lives in the house opposite.  It's not long before Sgt. Blackitt appears on the scene.  When he is followed by Sgt. Watt Graham has little to do but sit in the car and watch.

videos.title: Bring Back The Cat
videos.overview: It's a lively evening for Smith and Weir.  First they have to try and cope with a woman who is charging her husband with an unusual theft.  Then they have to intervene when two dockers engage in a punch-up, deal with a pensioner who thinks that the police are trying to steal his money, and finally confront a Scots tearaway who is handy with a shovel but is more interested in the works of Sir Walter Scott.

videos.title: If He Runs - Grab Him
videos.overview: An old lady is assaulted and robbed.  She manages to struggle home to her companion and soon both the cars and DCI Barlow are on the scene.

videos.title: First Foot
videos.overview: New Year's Eve in Newtown means a three-line whip for the lads on the cars.  Everyone has to be on the job to cope with the drunks, the rowdy parties and aggression in the pubs.  Then there is the thief using the occasion to carry out some quiet breaking and entering, and the teenage girl, daughter of a loveless home, looking for brief happiness by running away with a sailor.

videos.title: Think On
videos.overview: A bus load of witnesses - and not one with a voice.  Pub closing time in Newtown has come to mean more than the problem of drunken passengers for the men who crew the buses on route no. 86.  It has come to be a time to be feared - a time when violence strikes.

videos.title: The Luck Of The Game
videos.overview: Some parents' trouble is that they protect their children too much.

videos.title: I Love You Bonzo
videos.overview: Lynch is on the trail of an artist of a thief who broke into the Seaport Supermarket.

videos.title: Brotherly Love
videos.overview: In any community you'll find a few people who are out of alignment - and all too often they find themselves involved with the police.

videos.title: A Matter Of Give And Take
videos.overview: The suspicions of a canal lock-keeper bring Z-Victor One into contact with the canal community and eventually lead to the investigation of a more serious crime.

videos.title: Give A Dog A Name
videos.overview: A lost constable, but Sgt. Watt refuses to join his colleagues in jumping to conclusions.  PC Boyle has been transferred to Newtown with a black mark on his record.  Everyone knows why, and only John Watt is convinced of Boyle's good character.

videos.title: The Long Spoon
videos.overview: Barlow accepts a favour from a local trader - and his integrity becomes suspect.

videos.title: Teething Trouble
videos.overview: A child cries, and family man PC Baker finds himself getting too involved.

videos.title: A Shame To Take The Money
videos.overview: Two men carry off a mechanical shovel from a building site.

videos.title: Window Dressing
videos.overview: When No. 18 alarm bell rings in Newtown station Watt and Blackitt brace themselves for trouble.  For No. 18 is Mercer's Universal Stores and Mr. Mercer is a notoriously difficult character.

videos.title: Partners
videos.overview: A doctor is accused of indecent assault, and Barlow is faced with the problem of evidence.  And when a jailbird is found in possession of a stolen watch it looks to Lynch like an open and shut case.  In both cases, however, there is a lack of conclusive evidence.

videos.title: The Fanatics
videos.overview: Baker and Graham take time out for a snack, but there's no let up when the division is invaded by Scots football fans.  Jock Weir becomes more than usually involved.

videos.title: You Got To Have Class
videos.overview: A child witnesses a crime against her father, but her mother refuses to co-operate with the police.  Fancy's always uncertain temper reaches boiling point.

videos.title: The Mice Will Play
videos.overview: A particularly nasty wave of 'flu has decimated the staff at Newtown with Barlow and Blackitt among the victims.  To add to the problems Weir and Baker are away sitting examinations, so a temporary team of Smith and Graham are manning Z_Victor One.  They investigate when a baby is found abandoned in a cafe, while Watt and Lynch cope with a mysterious outbreak of garden gate stealing on the North Estate.

videos.title: Sound An Alarm
videos.overview: Personal radio comes to Newtown - with disastrous results.

videos.title: The Soft Game
videos.overview: Toby, a man high up on the ledge of a derelict warehouse, is likely to jump off at the mere sight of a uniform.  It is up to Bert Lynch, desperately anxious not to reveal himself as a policeman, to gain Toby's confidence and talk him down.

videos.title: Snakes Alive
videos.overview: Some people will pinch anything - and sometimes they get more than they bargained for!

videos.title: Suspected Murder
videos.overview: Graham and Baker set out to look for a stolen car but instead come upon a far less trivial incident.  Someone has disappeared and the disappearance may be permanent.  Barlow has no choice but to call in the 'heavy brigade' from Headquarters.

videos.title: The Share-Out
videos.overview: It's time for the share-out from one of Newtown's holiday savings clubs.  £18,000 is in club funds.  John Watt has to give protection to the money overnight.  PCs Walker and Foster take turns in standing guard, but when the dawn comes and the money leaves for the share-out all is not well.

videos.title: Checkmate
videos.overview: Three suspects arrive in the Newtown area.  Graham and Baker are instructed to warn them off.  Lynch, using a different approach, finds himself drinking with them all evening.  Then two of the interlopers are found in a crashed car surrounded by very valuable antiques.  The case is important enough to keep Barlow working on his day off.

videos.title: Another Fairy Tale
videos.overview: When two masked men terrorise the wife of a bookmaker and rob his safe it looks like a local job, and only hours after his release from prison Henry McNeil is picked up in a stolen car.  But as Barlow remarks, a pro like McNeil will be caught only with his hands in the till.

videos.title: Market Square
videos.overview: Victor Division prepares for a Royal visit, but crime doesn't stop for the occasion.  Lynch makes a mistake and is left fumbling for excuses and a need for action.  His conscience will not easily let him forget his day in Market Square.

videos.title: Error of Judgement
videos.overview: PC Foster, helped by ex-boxer Len Phillips, breaks up a gang of youngsters blocking the pavement.  His unnecessarily rough treatment of the rowdies comes to the attention of Sgt. Blackitt, who sets about putting his house in order.

videos.title: Under Cover
videos.overview: The police have to deal with depravity in all its guises - both of the body and of the mind.

videos.title: One Good Turn
videos.overview: Watt, Blackitt and Smith try to help Benny Dunn.  Benny's mam won't let him into the house; he has nowhere to go, no money for food and there's something about him that softens even a policeman's heart.

videos.title: Warning Shots
videos.overview: It is PC Ken Baker's last day on Z-Victor Two.  He has been selected for further training at Police College.  He is looking forward to a peaceful day and a quiet drink with his mates after his shift.  However, when two shots are fired his farewell to Newtown is anything but peaceful.

videos.title: With A Pin
videos.overview: There is a local race meeting on and Barlow, as befitting his rank, has been assigned to keep an eye on Tattersall's.  Lynch is less fortunate: his beat is the car park, so far distant from the course that his chances of picking up useful information are limited.  A suitably dressed Blackitt, off duty, is present as a private punter.  Smith and Weir are cruising in Z-Victor One as usual.

videos.title: Wilful Destruction
videos.overview: PC Walker joins Dave Graham in Z-Victor Two - and finds himself thrown in at the deep end.

videos.title: Cop And Blow
videos.overview: The Lucky 13 Club opens in Seaport.  It is lush and plush with its professional dealers and croupiers, but it is not crooked.  But it attracts its share of mugs - and a frightened woman.

videos.title: The Hard-Face Grabber
videos.overview: It's all very well taking in a stray, but Sgt. Blackitt thinks this one might bite the hand that feeds it.

videos.title: Inspection
videos.overview: Newtown nick is awaiting an official visit by H.M. Inspector of Constabulary.  The station is spick and span, gleaming with polish, when in walks a miner, straight from the coal face, dripping coal dust over everything.  He wants to confess to his part in the theft of a forty feet long shed the previous night.  Blackitt is furious and desperately tries to persuade the miner to come back later.  The argument is at its height when H.M. Inspector arrives.

videos.title: Routine Inquiries
videos.overview: Is a man lying?  Lynch has to decide for himself and act accordingly.

videos.title: A Morning's Sport
videos.overview: Three boys are bashing away at a piano which has been left on the street.  Watt thinks he knows which bunch of practical jokers put it there.  But the whole resources of Newtown station are rushed to the marshes at Seaport where a pair of 'sportsmen' get trapped by their own ignorance and folly.

videos.title: Contrary To Regulations
videos.overview: What happened to Jean Roe, who is found unconscious on the floor in an upstairs flat?  To Graham and Walker it looks like a straightforward case of assault.  But this is only the beginning and soon they find themselves involved in a case of drug addiction.

videos.title: The Good Life
videos.overview: A night watchman's hut is heaven to Patsy and Alfie, but it's back to earth with a bump when Fancy Smith turns up a card.

videos.title: Celebration
videos.overview: Sgt. Blackitt takes his wife Alice out to dinner to celebrate his 25 years on the force.  He has reason to celebrate, but events force him to realise that over-zealous attention to duty can have serious consequences.

videos.title: But The Crying ...
videos.overview: When Brian Logan unlawfully courts two women at the same time, the end can only mean unhappiness, not to mention problems for Smith and Weir.  Lynch has to finish the case, but without much help from Barlow, who has promotion and transfer on his mind.

videos.title: I Don't Want Evidence Part 1
videos.overview: A fire that killed an entire family is determined to have been deliberately set. (Part 1 of 2)

videos.title: I Don't Want Evidence Part 2
videos.overview: A fire has killed the whole Bohn family - and it didn't start accidentally.

videos.title: Ever Seen A Happy Cop Part 1
Ever Seen A Happy Cop Part 2
videos.overview: While on his beat PC Tate finds the gate of a local timber yard open.  Over the pocket radio he informs HQ.  From the station Sgt. Lynch warns him: ""A Z-Car is on its way - don't try to earn a medal.""

videos.title: You Want 'Em - You Find 'Em Part 2
videos.overview: DCS Miller has forced DI Hudson, under the threat of being sent back to a little desk job at H.Q., to tell him about an armed attempt to 'knock off' a prison van and release its occupant.

videos.title: All They Have To Do Is Spend It Part 1
All They Have To Do Is Spend It Part 2
Who Said Anything About The Law Part 1
Who Said Anything About The Law Part 2
When Did You Last See Your Father? Part 1
When Did You Last See Your Father? Part 2
When Did You Last See Your Father? Part 3
When Did You Last See Your Father? Part 4
videos.overview: The men who patrol their beats in the little Panda cars are not supposed to poach on the preserves of the C.I.D., but that's exactly what Alec May does.  It's a case which involves an outbreak of safe-stealing from farms and a deaf and dumb little boy who likes to watch trains.  May's own part in the affair looks like having serious consequences for his career.

videos.title: She's Not Yours, She's Mine Part 1
She's Not Yours, She's Mine Part 2
Don't Wrap It Up, I'll Take It With Me Part 1
Don't Wrap It Up, I'll Take It With Me Part 2
I Never Mean't To Drop Him Part 1
I Never Mean't To Drop Him Part 2
Never Give A Copper An Even Break Part 1
Never Give A Copper An Even Break Part 2
The Sledgehammer And The Nut Part 1
The Sledgehammer And The Nut Part 2
Play It Hot, Play It Cool Part 1
Play It Hot, Play It Cool Part 2
It's Easy Once You Know How Part 1
It's Easy Once You Know How Part 2
If I Can't Have Him Part 1
If I Can't Have Him Part 2
A Litte Bit Of Respect Part 1
A Litte Bit Of Respect Part 2
The Nose On Your Face Part 1
The Nose On Your Face Part 2
All In A Day's Work Part 1
All In A Day's Work Part 2
They're Not Supposed To Do That - Are They? Part 1
They're Not Supposed To Do That - Are They? Part 2
You Can't Win Em All Part 1
You Can't Win Em All Part 2
Take It With A Pinch Of Salt Part 1
Take It With A Pinch Of Salt Part 2
Inside Information Part 2
videos.overview: The Newtown police are baffled by a series of burglaries.  The thief's method of entry is undetectable, but the chaos in the houses he visits points to the work of an amateur.  DI Todd is baffled and it is DC Kane, working on the case with Sgt. Stone, who stumbles on the crook's ingenious method of entry.

videos.title: Out Of The Frying Pan Part 1
Out Of The Frying Pan Part 2
A Hobby You Might Say Part 1
A Hobby You Might Say Part 2
The Saint Of Concrete Canyon Part 1
The Saint Of Concrete Canyon Part 2
videos.overview: The saint of the title is one Ted Crowther, who lives in a fairly new block of flats known as Concrete Canyon.  He has earned his title because of his good works on behalf of the tenants.  A little boy, Billy Darby, goes missing from the flats because he believes he is going to lose his pet hamster, as the Council won't allow pets in the flats.  Crowther naturally is right there with the police to help look for Billy.  But Crowther also runs a Savings Club for the tenants and this attracts the interest of DI Todd.

videos.title: The Man Who Was Inspector Todd Part 1
The Man Who Was Inspector Todd Part 2
videos.overview: DI Todd's wallet is stolen and with it goes his warrant card - his means of identification as a Police Officer.  The thieves have the chance to work some profitable confidence tricks.

videos.title: Some Girls Pick 'Em Part 2
videos.overview: Her love for a man on the run lands a girl in trouble with the law.

videos.title: The Battleground Part 2
videos.overview: Eleven year old Johnny Benson, unhappy at home because of his parents' constant bickering, takes refuge in religion.  After being sacked as an altar boy he sets fire to an altar cloth.  A visit from Sgt. Stone throws him into a panic and he runs away.

videos.title: The Witness Part 2
videos.overview: Alec Hughes is a key witness to a bank hold-up for which Chris Morgan is being charged.  DI Todd is afraid there may be attempts to intimidate Hughes and so he sends him to stay with Culshaw.

videos.title: The Guilty Ones Part 2
videos.overview: A fifteen year old girl is missing and when PC Culshaw finds her she begs him not to take her home.

videos.title: At Least You Know You've Tried Part 1
At Least You Know You've Tried Part 2
videos.overview: A young engaged couple have spent six months decorating and furnishing their new home, when two weeks before their marriage someone breaks in and smashes everything up.  They are the latest victims of 'the destructive thief'.

videos.title: Two's A Pair Part 2
videos.overview: Edna Clayton, who once had a crush on DI Todd and pursued him shamelessly, is brought into Newtown police station charged with being drunk and disorderly.  Todd at first takes no notice; he has other things on his mind.

videos.title: Tomorrow's Another Day Part 2
videos.overview: With DI Todd on leave and DC Kane away sick, Sgt. Stone has more than enough to do.  And then just to complicate things the A.C.C. decides to arrive at Newtown station two weeks before time for his customary three months' inspection.  On top of all this £200 is missing from the safe in the cashier's office of Carters Ltd., and Stone must investigate.

videos.title: Who Was That Lady? Part 2
videos.overview: Angry domineering Mrs. Armitage calls at Newtown station to report her window cleaner husband as a missing person.  Sgt. Lynch sympathises with Ernie Armitage's decision to 'hop it' and uses it to serve as a warning to PC Newcombe, who seems to be heading at top speed to the altar.

videos.title: Talk Your Way Out Of That Part 1
Talk Your Way Out Of That Part 2
videos.overview: Lynch is having a quiet drink in a pub when he is spotted by Danny Matthews, a villain Lynch helped put away for a long stretch.  Matthews is out for revenge.  But Lynch suspects him of pulling another job... and the battle of wits begins.

videos.title: Application Part 2
videos.overview: The new Detective Inspector arrives at Newtown and Sgt. Stone is anxious to know the kind of man he is.  He soon finds out when on their first meeting DI Witty presents Stone with a rather unexpected task.

videos.title: The Luck Of The Irish Part 1
The Luck Of The Irish Part 2
videos.overview: Looking into the matter of stolen copper from a building site, Roach and Bannerman meet Billy Alty, the site foreman, who rules his Irish labourers with the law of his own two fists.  But the Irish have their own laws too, and trouble is brewing.

videos.title: A Kind Of Proof Part 2
videos.overview: Roach and Bannerman are called to a sub-post office where the postmistress, Miss Powell, has been attacked and robbed.  Miss Powell describes her attacker, and in particular the blow he dealt her - a kind of karate chop.

videos.title: A Matter For Thought Part 2
videos.overview: Jack Egerton has been stabbed and DI Witty rushes to the hospital in the hope of getting a statement from the man.  But Egerton is in a critical condition and Witty has to look elsewhere for the circumstances of the stabbing.  And what he finds out is puzzling, to say the least.

videos.title: Some Kind Of Nut Part 2
videos.overview: Newtown station receives a call from a man who says he has 'put a bomb in'.  Sgt. Stone deduces from the man's words that this is not just another hoax and the hunt begins for the man and the bomb, which is due to explode at midnight.

videos.title: He Must Be Up To No Good Part 1
He Must Be Up To No Good Part 2
videos.overview: Holiday fortnight for the building trades is coming up.  The firms are paying a fortnight's wages and the banks are carrying extra cash.  So when well-known criminal Vincent Lewis arrives in Newtown a watch is kept to find out what he's up to.

videos.title: It's A Sort Of Game Part 1
It's A Sort Of Game Part 2
videos.overview: One of those 'nice quiet nights' at Newtown station and Sgt. Stone is just preparing to leave for home.  Then the window of a pet shop is broken and Z-Victor One is called to a domestic disturbance, with a report of shouts and possible screams.

videos.title: Anyone Can Make A Mistake Part 1
Anyone Can Make A Mistake Part 2
videos.overview: Roach and Bannerman are called to a cinema where a man has been caught trying to steal from a patron's handbag.  The man claims he'd dropped his cigarette lighter and was searching for it in the darkness.  A poor excuse, maybe, but Roach believes the man.

videos.title: Attack Part 2
videos.overview: A shotgun is fired into the air, the action freezing the staff and customers in a sub post office.  The postman is the only one to take any action at all, and he suffers from it.

videos.title: You Worry Too Much, Charlie Part 1
You Worry Too Much, Charlie Part 2
videos.overview: The salesman at Mather's garage is very obliging, so if you want to buy a car there's no need to worry about the full amount of the deposit.  But Charlie Dodd worries.  He's a mechanic at Mather's.

videos.title: Punch-Up Part 2
videos.overview: Bannerman enters for an inter-divisional boxing match and is curious to know why DI Witty begins to take an almost fanatical interest in his training.  Then a punch-up of a far more serious nature takes place near Bartley's fairground.

videos.title: More Ways Of Killing The Cat Part 1
More Ways Of Killing The Cat Part 2
No Charge For The Estimate Part 1
No Charge For The Estimate Part 2
videos.overview: Granny Wendy, an old woman who lives alone, is the victim of what appears to be a domestic accident.  But when Roach and Bannerman find the old woman's purse is missing they suspect foul play.

videos.title: The Paperchase Part 2
videos.overview: A long distance lorry driver parks overnight in a Newtown car park, leaving a girl hitchhiker sleeping in the cab.  Neither of them knows that a robbery is due to take place in the car park that night.

videos.title: The Tip-Off Part 2
videos.overview: Bannerman, off duty with his girl friend, meets Ted Holmes in a pub.  Holmes has some information to sell and wants cash.  Bannerman senses the information is good, but is it?

videos.title: Prevention Is Better Part 2
videos.overview: Sgt. Stone sees two youths, Billy and Vic Redmond, trying car door handles in Newtown Centre.  Their father is serving time in Walton jail and the two lads look like following in his footsteps.  But Stone, as Crime Prevention Officer, decides to take a hand.

videos.title: Special Relationship Part 2
videos.overview: Det. Supt. Oakley calls on Sgt. Stone with a request.  Oakley is anxious for Stone to nail Timmy Cater, a safe-blower now living on the Newtown patch.  Stone has a 'special relationship' with Cater which will make it easier to set Cater up.

videos.title: A Proper George Washington Part 2
videos.overview: Eighteen year old Michael Adams says he was coming home from the pictures when his attacker came up behind him, knocked him unconscious and robbed him.  Roach and Bannerman doubt the boy's story, but why should he be lying?

videos.title: I Know My Coppers Part 2
videos.overview: When the money is recovered from a raid on a security van it is placed in a cell in Newtown police station for safe keeping.  But how safe is it?

videos.title: Follow The Form Part 2
videos.overview: Ron Bailey, a petrol pump attendant at a Newtown garage, is approached by two men who want him to help them rob a safe in the garage office.  When DI Witty hears Bailey's story he is inclined to disbelieve it and senses a conspiracy.

videos.title: Breakdown Part 2
videos.overview: Roach and Bannerman are called to investigate a minor theft reported by a lecturer at a Technical College.  The lecturer is th guardian of Roger, a fourteen-year-old boy.  Roach and Bannerman are required to interview Roger, but the boy is stone deaf.

videos.title: Will He...Won't He? Part 2
videos.overview: PC Newcombe, searching for a girl who has been reported missing, learns that she is hiding out in a disused factory.  When he gets there he finds more than he bargained for.

videos.title: Dead End Part 2
videos.overview: Sgt. Lynch is paying a social call on an old friend, a nurse, when a man arrives at the Nursing Home breathless and frightened.  He has found the body of a woman in a lay-by.

videos.title: Blame It On Father Christmas Part 1
Blame It On Father Christmas Part 2
videos.overview: With only two days to go until Christmas, Bobby Dawson, having returned from carol singing, tells his mother that the man at No. 52 was very generous: he gave Bobby five shillings.  But the family at No. 52 have gone away for Christmas....

videos.title: For Auld Lang Syne Part 2
videos.overview: Two Scotsmen visit Newtown during the New Year celebrations to seek out an old acquaintance of theirs, a fellow villain, who, they believed, helped the police to jail them.  When the Newtown police hear they've arrived they prepare themselves for trouble.

videos.title: Unidentified Marks Part 1
videos.overview: On evening patrol Roach and Bannerman are curious about a man sitting alone in a parked car.  When questioned the man runs and scales a ten foot wall like an athlete.

videos.title: Picture Of Guilt Part 2
videos.overview: After a raid on a cinema a doorman is shot.  A reporter from a Sunday newspaper meets Harris, an informer, in a pub.  Harris has information about the raid which he will sell if the price is right.  He swears he has proof - the best possible kind of proof.

videos.title: It Works Both Ways Part 2
videos.overview: ""From what I know of these kids they don't go in for crime as we know it.  All they want is excitement through violence.  There's nothing for them to do so they make their own amusements, picking on people, six against one.""

videos.title: Alibi Part 2
videos.overview: ""It was Saturday night when he did the break-in.  Got in through a lavatory window and tore his sleeve on a nail.  Then he hit the watchman.  Even if I have to adjourn the Court to the old man's bedside I'll get evidence to break this damned alibi...""

videos.title: Lost Property Part 2
videos.overview: ""A man came yesterday.  Said he had shared a cell with my husband.  Said my Alfie was coming out of prison in the morning.  Needed his overcoat.  So I gave this man the overcoat and my husband's best suit.  I was at the gate this morning.  Nobody handed in the clothes and my Alfie's still inside...""

videos.title: Fear Or Favour Part 2
videos.overview: Like all areas Newtown has its share of vandalism.  A group of youths - voices - a crash of glass - the sound of footsteps running down the street.  But on this night vandalism has extended itself to robbery and physical violence.  Three youths are brought in as suspects; one with a difference.

videos.title: The Lonely Place Part 2
videos.overview: An attack on a courting couple in a lonely place... a man appearing and asking for a light.. a frightened girl running for help.  When questioned the couple cannot, or will not, identify their attacker.

videos.title: The Soft Touch Part 2
videos.overview: Watching... timing... speed... picking the right vehicle... quick disposal.  All the ingredients of wholesale car theft, well organised and well executed.  Newtown police find that they have such an organisation on their patch.

videos.title: Special Duty Part 2
videos.overview: Special Duty can be easy or hazardous.  A man can be a decoy or a sitting duck.  He is alone and he cannot easily predict what action will take place.  PC Roach realises this when he is assigned to such a duty.  And yet he volunteered for the task, was not forced into taking it.  But if your face fits...

videos.title: One End of The Road Part 1
One End of The Road Part 2
videos.overview: A constable has been seriously injured.  It could be that his career as a policeman is finished.  There is an atmosphere in Newtown station and DI Witty is called upon to answer for the incident.

videos.title: Welcome To Newtown Part 2
videos.overview: A Dakota aeroplane with 32 passengers aboard is in difficulties.  The pilot intends to make an emergency landing and Newtown prepares itself for a major incident.

videos.title: All The Birds Of The Air Part 1
All The Birds Of The Air Part 2
videos.overview: With new technical resources we are half way to an automated police force, so why not automated thieves as well?  Thieves with all the mechanical tricks, one step ahead of the police.  The birds of the air - listening in.

videos.title: Not A Bad Lad Really Part 1
Not A Bad Lad Really Part 2
videos.overview: Thirty-nine break-ins in five weeks: each one on pay nights at council estates.  On paper a serious setback for DI Goss's detection rate, made even more complicated by the most obvious suspect just finishing probation.

videos.title: Snout Part 2
videos.overview: Officially a police informant does not exist... information is obtained from the birds.  So when a snout stands in danger of reprisals who is to protect him?

videos.title: The Exiles Part 2
videos.overview: Even the best villains have to retire someday.  But if, like Dixie Conlan, you don't want to retire, you find an apprentice: someone young and eager enough to follow in your footsteps.

videos.title: It's Not Against The Law Part 1
It's Not Against The Law Part 2
videos.overview: PC Bannerman risks his life trying to save a child, but what kind of mother could invite such a risk in the first place?  What kind of mother could leave a child alone in a house with a lighted oil heater?

videos.title: Hit And Run Part 2
videos.overview: A man walks into Newtown police station and demands to be given a breathalyser test, but does not appear to be drunk.  Why then is he so insistent?

videos.title: One Of Our Own Part 2
videos.overview: WPC Parkin is an able and efficient officer with a bright career ahead of her.  So why should she risk it all by cultivating a close friendship with a known criminal?

videos.title: No Objection To Bail Part 2
videos.overview: Stand as surety for someone and you risk them running away from the law leaving you to forfeit the bail money or go to prison yourself.  But a man does not expect this sort of treatment; not from a nephew he believes to be innocent.

videos.title: Sunday...Sunday... Part 2
videos.overview: It's Sunday and three young tearaways have nothing to do and nowhere to go.  But they have a souped-up car and they need their kicks, so if anyone gets in their way...

videos.title: Double Game Part 2
videos.overview: Sgt. Stone and Ben Stacey have an old score to settle.  So why should Stacey now want to help the police?

videos.title: Spare The Rod Part 2
videos.overview: Some teachers, like policemen, live in a jungle.  Civilised men and women, living under pressure.  Then something snaps...

videos.title: You've Got To Keep Them Talking Part 1
You've Got To Keep Them Talking Part 2
videos.overview: The seed of suicide is in all of us.  So when an innocent old woman becomes involved with the police and becomes irrational, is this a warning light?

videos.title: In Need Of Care Part 2
videos.overview: ""What sort of life will I have if I stay in Newtown?  Wrapping sweets at Brownley's eight hours a day; listening to Radio One; marry some yob and get a council house if I'm lucky.  Half a dozen kids in half a dozen years.  D'yer call that living?""

videos.title: From Information Received Part 2
videos.overview: Les Mitcham and Phil Andrews are working as painters on a new housing estate.  Mitcham, the younger of the men, has served two short terms of imprisonment.  Andrews, from the Midlands, is a more experienced criminal.  They have planned a job together.  As it will be Mitcham's first attempt at big-time crime they require a third man.  Mitcham, anxious to ingratiate himself, says he knows someone.  When the job has been pulled PC Quilley finds a source of information.  ""It's teamwork that gets results,"" says Sgt. Stone.  Why, then, is the job taken out of Quilley's hands?

videos.title: Have A Go, Joe Part 2
videos.overview: In a major crime every policeman dreams of finding a key witness - but not a witness who is too scared to talk.

videos.title: The Shooter Part 2
videos.overview: If you know the right places and you're the sort of man who needs a gun it is possible to acquire one.  They cost money, but when the offer is a fiver down and a percentage of your first job you might be tempted.

videos.title: Dear Old Golden Rule Days Part 1
Dear Old Golden Rule Days Part 2
videos.overview: Alec Quilley plucks up courage to contact Beth, an old flame, but for her the glow is fading.  Chris, her new boy friend and old schoolmate of Quilley's, seems to be living well beyond his apparent means.  Protective hackles raised, Quilley's unofficial enquiries about Chris and Goss's investigation of a series of petty thefts and minor break-ins begin to find common ground.

videos.title: Allegation Part 2
videos.overview: A serious road accident, a child missing, a drunk in the cells who won't come to.  At times a police station is like a wartime command post under siege, with even the policemen themselves at breaking point.

videos.title: You Can't Trust Anyone Part 2
videos.overview: Go to your local pub for a quiet drink, chat up the barmaid, take her out and forget about crime for a while.  But as Sgt. Stone discovers, a policeman can't avoid crime - it even invades his private life.

videos.title: The Dog Lover Part 2
videos.overview: Tommy Woods has a way with dogs and a way with women.  There's nothing they wouldn't do for him.

videos.title: It's Been A Long Time Part 1
It's Been A Long Time Part 2
videos.overview: Pete Simmonds is out from prison looking for the man who informed on him.  But not only the informer has to live in fear of reprisals.  Simmonds is strong and violent and the witnesses at his trial were promised police protection on the day of his release.

videos.title: Not That Sort Of Policeman Part 1
Not That Sort Of Policeman Part 2
videos.overview: A gelignite explosion has wrecked an office and probably injured the men responsible - all for the sake of twenty pounds.  But where do the police start looking for dangerous amateurs who are prepared to take risks?

videos.title: Lost And Found Part 2
videos.overview: What sort of mother abandons her two month old baby in a telephone kiosk?

videos.title: Gyppo Part 2
videos.overview: 'He's lived on canal boats all his life.  Born on one - never been to school.  Not the sort of man one can lock up in a cell.'

videos.title: Give A Dog A Bad Name Part 1
Give A Dog A Bad Name Part 2
videos.overview: No alibi - a criminal record - picked out on an identity parade.  Is that proof enough of a man's guilt?

videos.title: Nobody Loves Us Part 2
videos.overview: A rock is thrown at a passenger train and the driver is injured.  The Transport Union want the police to take some sort of action, but where do the police start looking for teenage vandals?

videos.title: A Right Cock-n-Bull Story Part 2
videos.overview: Sgt. Stone, with Bannerman and Newcombe, goes to the City Airport to investigate a bomb hoax.  No bomb is found, but the police discover something else that is just as explosive.

videos.title: Two For The Record Part 2
videos.overview: A man and his wife report the theft of a strange assortment of objects from their home, and they want the thief, their son, brought to justice.

videos.title: Quiet Day Part 2
videos.overview: Three honest citizens, strangers to each other, decide almost simultaneously to take the town apart.  Spontaneous acts, in three separate places, yet all at the same time.

videos.title: None The Worse Part 4
videos.overview: A woman is found dead.  The police get a description of the man responsible, then his name, Gleeson - the Crown's principal witness for a similar murder eight years ago.

videos.title: The Best Day Of The Year Part 1
The Best Day Of The Year Part 2
videos.overview: A quiet sort of Christmas.  People on the move, relaxed.  Bannerman goes to the theatre, DI Goss to a private do.  Sgt. Lynch is on his way home for the holiday.  And Buzz Bentley, hard nut from London, has come to Newtown.

videos.title: Score To Settle Part 2
videos.overview: A new police constable, Joe Skinner, is assigned to the crime cars.  Kardar, a Hungarian and an expert with explosives, has a score to settle with a certain policeman.

videos.title: Tune On A Bent Trumpet Part 1
Tune On A Bent Trumpet Part 2
videos.overview: DI Bowen, once DI Goss's superior officer, has been accused of discreditable conduct and he wants Goss to help him.  But the Newtown force has another problem on its plate - an escaped prisoner armed with a shotgun.

videos.title: They Call It Justice Part 2
videos.overview: A child is badly injured in a road accident, a job for Traffic, not Crime.  But Sgt. Lynch has a personal interest in this particular accident.

videos.title: No Questions Asked Part 2
videos.overview: With a sharp increase in petty theft having been recorded, Stone and Goss are anxious to get the top man.  A policeman with the local nickname 'Mr. Fixit' comes in for heavy scrutiny.

videos.title: Threats And Menaces Part 2
videos.overview: Frank Caunce, crippled by a roof fall during the course of an arrest by Sgt. Stone, has been released from prison.  Stone feels that his disability should keep him quiet, but...

videos.title: Lost Part 2
videos.overview: A nine year old by is lost on Moor Top while helping his 'uncle' look for strayed sheep.  Rough weather, fading light - and another complication perhaps more serious, the boy's 'uncle' himself.

videos.title: Infamous Conduct Part 2
videos.overview: A struck-off doctor cannot prescribe drugs or medicine and cannot sign a death certificate.  What would such a doctor do if old friends and sympathisers came to him for help?

videos.title: All Coppers Are Nanas Part 2
videos.overview: There's a lot of old villains in the new flats at Alexander House.  On cold nights, with the lifts out of order, they tend to stay in - but not the younger ones.  Micky Pye, for instance.

videos.title: Nice Bit O' Stuff Part 2
videos.overview: Under the new act couples can marry at eighteen, but there are still strong family traditions.  ""Wait till you're twenty-one - key of the door"".  But not for Valma Yorke.

videos.title: For Old Time's Sake Part 2
videos.overview: There have been two armed wage snatches within a couple of weeks, both of a similar pattern.  Police believe it to be the work of one team.  But then there is a third robbery, distinctly different from the other two.

videos.title: A Day Like Every Day Part 1
A Day Like Every Day Part 2
videos.overview: ""Squirts the window catch with an oil can first, then uses a knife.  Vernon's style.  One day he'll probably come face to face with a householder - what happens then?""

videos.title: Eleanor Rigby Slept Here Part 2
videos.overview: Helen Carter, a nervous woman, has lived alone for too long.  Then she has a 'visitor', a man who stands outside her door each night.  While trying to trace the 'visitor' Lynch finds himself involved with the woman herself.

videos.title: A Right Tommy Kelly Do Part 1
A Right Tommy Kelly Do Part 2
videos.overview: The Brice brothers run Clyde Street.  There are frequent beatings-up but no witnesses.  Then PC Quilley is invited to a wedding by a member of the Brice fraternity.  There is another beating-up at the wedding and Quilley is called before Goss to explain his association with known villains.

videos.title: Cruising For Burglars Part 2
videos.overview: A Liverpool City policeman is shot.  Newtown police learn that the two men responsible could be heading for their patch, still carrying the gun.  The two men are tired, frightened and dangerous.

videos.title: In And Out Part 4
videos.overview: An old lag agrees to deliver a message on his release from prison.  His son is on the run from Borstal and trouble is their way of life.

videos.title: It's Only A Game Part 2
videos.overview: The 'Stiffs' - Newtown's local soccer team - have relegation problems.  The last thing they need is malicious attacks from the public.  The latest act of wilful damage leaves the police wondering.  There are plenty of suspects and plenty of motives, but is that enough?

videos.title: A Quiet Sort Of Lad Part 1
A Quiet Sort Of Lad Part 2
videos.overview: Johnny Marsh is an isolated teenager: he thinks alone, thinks of the past.  A little thing, and something snaps.  His obsession leads him into crime and violence.  The police have to trace that obsession - back into the past.

videos.title: Night Out Part 2
videos.overview: Two young brothers are drowned in a canal.  Newcombe, Quilley and Skinner are there on a night out.  Like others they want to forget their job for a while, but the evening has gone sour.

videos.title: One Bad Apple Part 2
videos.overview: Stolen goods which have disappeared; a search warrant that is useless.  The villains are laughing at Newtown police - they have an informer within the ranks of the Law.  Supt. Oakley suspects a member of the Newtown force.

videos.title: If You Can't Beat 'Em Part 2
videos.overview: Money is missing in a shop.  Nield is pushed for cash and he's an ex-convict.

videos.title: Couldn't Happer To A Nicer Girl Part 1
Couldn't Happer To A Nicer Girl Part 2
videos.overview: June Frazer is brought in for theft; her father is brought in for drunkenness and the police find a frightened woman.

videos.title: A Couple Of Comic Turns Part 1
A Couple Of Comic Turns Part 2
videos.overview: Bernard Spencer enjoys newspaper publicity of his crimes, but what lengths will he go to to obtain such publicity?  He is staying at the Orchard Hotel.  And members of the police force are there too - on unofficial business.

videos.title: By Bread Alone Part 2
videos.overview: An old woman is attacked and robbed and there seem to be no witnesses.  Only Pearson was in a position to see anything, but there is something strange about him.

videos.title: The Helpers Part 2
videos.overview: Church doors are open to everyone.  Solace is always available - but church property isn't.  The police are seeking a thief with a grudge - against religion.

videos.title: Missile Mile Part 2
videos.overview: A car crashes on the motorway but this is no ordinary accident.  Goss thinks he is chasing someone who is lonely, brooding and probably violent.  Maybe even a nutcase.

videos.title: I wouldn't give you tuppence... Part 1
I wouldn't give you tuppence... Part 2
videos.overview: A load of railway telephone wire is 'knocked off'  Newtown's scrap metal merchants are questioned and something is revealed.  A bobby is taking bribes.

videos.title: Weekend With Sally Part 2
videos.overview: John Meaker reports his wife missing.  Because of the disturbing circumstances the search is not an easy one.

videos.title: Bottoms Up For The Walking Dead Part 1
Bottoms Up For The Walking Dead Part 2
videos.overview: The Ramp is a wasteland - it is a dangerous area to be in at night alone.  Doc is a native of The Ramp, and by helping the police has put himself in immediate danger.

videos.title: Give And Take Part 2
videos.overview: Saturday afternoon is a time for football and weddings.  People are expecting a good match.  But not everyone IS a good match.

videos.title: Who's Sylvia Then Part 1
videos.overview: Brian Bennett talks about someone called Sylvia.  He implies something might have happened to the girl.  Although they have no evidence that the girl ever existed the police mount a search for Sylvia.

videos.title: Who's Sylvia Then Part 2
videos.overview: Brian Bennett talks about someone called Sylvia.  He implies something terrible might have happened to the girl.  Although they have no evidence that the girl ever existed the police mount a search for Sylvia.

videos.title: A Lot Of Fuss For 15 Quid Part 1
A Lot Of Fuss For 15 Quid Part 2
videos.overview: Sheila Ashton has a neat line in petty thefts.  She also has a partner in crime - a twelve year old child.

videos.title: The Other Arm Of The Law Part 1
The Other Arm Of The Law Part 2
videos.overview: Roy and Mary Chadwick are looking for people who can be persuaded to part with their money.  And they've found an ideal victim.

videos.title: To Ray - Love Anne Part 2
videos.overview: Raymond Pritchard doesn't have much to say for himself.  Maybe he's got something to hide.  Skinner has a lot of questions for Pritchard - and he wants a few answers.

videos.title: A Big Shadow Part 2
videos.overview: Gerald has been discharged from a mental hospital after thirty years and he has a record of violence.  Now two men have been attacked.

videos.title: The Senior Partner Part 2
videos.overview: Frank Livesey is an ex-prisoner who is getting on a bit.  And easy money is hard to come by when you're nearly past it.

videos.title: Talking To An Elephant Part 2
videos.overview: A circus comes to Newtown.  It attracts the public - and trouble.

videos.title: Off With The Motley Part 2
videos.overview: A clown is supposed to make children laugh, but he doesn't have to like them.  But can you have a circus without one of the clowns?

videos.title: Whatever Happened To The Glory Boy? Part 1
Whatever Happened To The Glory Boy? Part 2
videos.overview: Joe Hart's out of the spotlight now, but some people still remember him.  Others would sooner forget.

videos.title: Have You Seen Davie Richards? Part 1
Have You Seen Davie Richards? Part 2
videos.overview: A man has been given a day's unescorted parole from prison.  But that was a year ago and he hasn't been seen since.  To Goss and Stone falls the task of searching for him.

videos.title: A Very High Rocket Part 2
videos.overview: Never stick your neck out, that's good advice.  But what do you do if you suspect someone - look the other way?  Alec Quilley gets tired of having mud slung and takes some action of his own.

videos.title: A Little Woman Part 2
videos.overview: Bert Lynch tries to help Dixie Conlan's widow to go on living.  Jack Streeter's no good for her and Lynch knows it.  But does Maggie?

videos.title: Stop Over Part 2
videos.overview: John Glass has returned to the North for more than just a 'quiet life'.  And Inspector Goss knows it.  As events come to a head Goss decides to keep Glass at the station to stew for a while.

videos.title: Strictly Cash Part 2
videos.overview: There's one born every minute!  And nobody knows that better than the tallyman.  Billy and Moira intend to stay in Newtown, but Sgt. Lynch has other ideas.

videos.title: Playing For Keeps Part 2
videos.overview: Teenagers need adventure and a change of scene just as much as adults.  But the adventure turns sour for Anne as she realises that it isn't a game.

videos.title: Christmas Is Coming Part 2
videos.overview: Some people take Christmas very very seriously.  They steal twice as much.  Bert Lynch is a victim - for the second time.

videos.title: Let Nothing You Dismay
videos.overview: Quilley and a milk float... Bagpipes... A hangover... A baby.

videos.title: Prevention Part 2
videos.overview: Detective Sergeant Bickford infiltrates a gang of villains and gets a jobâ€”as a murderer. (Part 2 of 2)

videos.title: Right Of Way Part 2
videos.overview: Charles Warren doesn't care how he gets people away from his property.  But if he breaks the law...  At the station they are far too busy to worry about the promotion rumours that are going round.

videos.title: Nobody Wins, Nobody Loses Part 1
videos.overview: A promotion cause commotion in Newtown...

videos.title: Nobody Wins, Nobody Loses Part 2
videos.overview: Night duty... Newcombe and Skinner... Promotion... and trouble.  Then the promotion comes out in orders and Newtown loses a policeman.

videos.title: By-Pass Part 2
videos.overview: A new Detective-Sergeant and Stone's old undetected crime.  Something to be uncovered.  A vehicle again waits near the by-pass for a victim.  Another victim just waits.

videos.title: Love's A Dead Lumber Part 2
videos.overview: Roy Gannon's out of prison and he's making for Newtown.  His ex-wife's there - and so is Skinner

videos.title: The More We Are Together Part 1
The More We Are Together Part 2
videos.overview: Newtown gets a new policeman and an unusual do-it-yourself expert.  Mrs. Manley gets a shock, and so does Inspector Goss when he reconstructs the crime.

videos.title: Make Yourself At Home Part 2
videos.overview: ""There's a sinister feller in a mac outside my flat,"" came the call.  Another villain in Newtown?  Maureen's heading straight for trouble and Lionel's not far behind.

videos.title: Triangle Squared Part 2
videos.overview: PC Covill's in dead trouble.  He doesn't realise how much until Z-Victor One is involved in a car chase.  A man with a record of violence comes the the station to report a murder.

videos.title: Hold Up Part 2
videos.overview: A cafe and someone waiting, wearing a stocking mask and carrying a a gun.  Two suspects, two detectives and a tough interrogation.  But then there is another hold-up.

videos.title: The Snoozer Part 2
videos.overview: And then there's the one about the commercial traveller, who works when everyone else has gone to bed...

videos.title: Influence Part 2
videos.overview: Perjury and corruption in the police force.  Sgt. Stone talks about blackmail to Rachel, to Lil and to Superintendent Khan.
