videos.title: It Can Get To Be A Habit Part 1
It Can Get To Be A Habit Part 2
videos.overview: ""The word may go round that the police aren't hard on this patch.  They need to be shown that we are"".

videos.title: Bad Tuesday
videos.overview: Quiet Mr. Potter's wife and daughter have disappeared.

videos.title: System
videos.overview: A lad walks into Newtown police station.  A scared lad, who has information.  So Sgt. Stone goes visiting.

videos.title: Say Two Hellos
videos.overview: Skinner meets two women.  He helps them for different reasons.

videos.title: The Taker
videos.overview: Patten has a record.  He takes what he wants, and if someone gets in the way...  So Patten goes to this club.  Smedley goes to hospital.  So Sgt. Stone goes after Patten.

videos.title: The Find
videos.overview: Gold!  Mention it and their eyes go green with envy.  Offer it and you get clutching hands.

videos.title: Lawbreakers
videos.overview: A man is brought in for something petty, but he refuses to speak.  Is he covering up for something bigger?  Then another man is brought in.

videos.title: Cars
videos.overview: For the 'mobile' police everything and anything can happen on a tour of duty.  And it does!

videos.title: Penny Wise
videos.overview: Do 'holidays in the sun' link a toaster sold in a pub and a woman losing her cheque book?

videos.title: No Job For A Woman
videos.overview: Alec Quilley's girl friend drives a taxi at night - when there are some dodgy people about.

videos.title: Territory
videos.overview: A man quietly enjoying the local playground; a crowd noisily enjoying the local pub.  Elsewhere work and much activity - police activity.

videos.title: The Stone Standard Part 2
videos.overview: Sergeant Stone - up against militant management and militant workers.  And he won't compromise.

videos.title: The Mystery Part 2
videos.overview: A teenage girl and night time at a railway station brings a problem for PC Covill.

videos.title: Nobody Hit Me Part 2
videos.overview: Two grocers, one across the road from the other.  Both ordinary, everyday characters.  But then one of them has a fire in his shop.  Goss and Stone end up with one villain and two very frightened men.

videos.title: Dan, Dan... Part 2
videos.overview: To get stolen goods to the public a villain has to be an organising genius, and that's not all.  The police are keeping an eye on Reg Thurley, who seems to be leading a double life.

videos.title: Who's Your Friend ... ? Part 2
videos.overview: Liam Murphy is losing control of the gang.  It's time for action.

videos.title: Purely Medical Purposes Part 2
videos.overview: Charlie West is found with stolen property.  He's in trouble, so he calls his lawyer.

videos.title: Grandstand Finish Part 2
videos.overview: Sunday is all quiet, but Monday brings 'Open Day' problems at the Station.  But there are more urgent troubles outside.

videos.title: Funny Creatures Women Part 2
videos.overview: Night, a deserted park and a young woman on her way home.  Skinner is interviewed by Goss and Stone.  Then they take the keys to his quarters.

videos.title: The Dirty Job Part 2
videos.overview: The Bannion family is in trouble, but at first not with the police.  Bannion can possibly help Goss catch a villain.  But is Goss willing to help Bannion in return?

videos.title: Ding Dong Part 2
videos.overview: Juvenile crime in Newtown has reached a serious level.  A clean-up campaign goes into operation.  Then the Sheldon mob arrive in town.

videos.title: Not Often We Have Visitors Part 1
Not Often We Have Visitors Part 2
videos.overview: There's a V.I.P. visit in the offing and everyone is making plans: Newtown police, Special Branch, Headquarters.  And they're not the only ones.  It's a straight line from the airport to the Remand Home.  And the roads should be fairly quiet.

videos.title: Contact Man Part 2
videos.overview: Three villains are under lock and key.  But where is the missing eight thousand pounds?  With business problems and an expensive wife Mr. Owen has lots of reasons to be worried, but there's another reason too.

videos.title: Take Away Part 2
videos.overview: Nicked cars are normally just a routine job.  So what makes Annette Minto's so different?  At first she just wants her car back, but then something makes her change her mind.

videos.title: Who Were You With? Part 2
videos.overview: A hairdresser's shop is wrecked.  In the middle is a frightened girl.  She's alone and vulnerable and it's night time.  She's no money and nowhere to go.  It's not surprising that she's scared.

videos.title: Danny Boy's Home Part 2
videos.overview: Danny Baker returns to Newtown.  But DS Haggar is back as well.  It's not long before the two of them lock antlers.

videos.title: The Horse Dealer Part 2
videos.overview: With Goss coming back Haggar wants to go out on a winner.  And even he has a friend or two willing to help him.

videos.title: Collation Part 2
videos.overview: Promotion is in the air and Goss is in with an outside chance.  A sighting, plus a report from a beat man, might just add up to a feather in Goss's cap at just the right time.

videos.title: Last Bus To Newtown
videos.overview: Bert Lynch has almost forgotten what life is like on the cars - out there in the thick of things.

videos.title: Lynch
videos.overview: Change.  New people.  Different methods.  Some people call it progress.  Bert Lynch, out on his own, is starting to feel left behind.  Not the best time for his surprise visitor to call.

videos.title: Team Work
videos.overview: Whether it's a family trying to adjust to change or the police force mounting a big crime prevention operation a team is only as strong as its weakest member.

videos.title: The Attackers
videos.overview: A lad is walking home late at night...

videos.title: Retirement
videos.overview: An old man tries to stop a robbery...

videos.title: Promotion
videos.overview: Police life often puts a strain on a marriage, as Goss finds out.  Stone is single, but that can also mean trouble.

videos.title: Canal
videos.overview: It's the age of fast getaways, but Frank and George are exceptions.  They're villains all the same and Sgt. Miller thinks they're worth watching.

videos.title: Week Off
videos.overview: Lynch tries to get away from it all...

videos.title: Missing
videos.overview: Mariam Ahmed makes some trouble for the police.

videos.title: Quilley
videos.overview: Quilley - on and off duty - with trouble on both fronts.

videos.title: Tessa In The Woodpile
videos.overview: After a robbery Tessa goes on the warpath.

videos.title: Keep To Yourself
videos.overview: Two loners.  Stone cops one of them, Skinner the other.

videos.title: Operation Ascalon
videos.overview: Is Goss to blame when the operation goes wrong?

videos.title: Short Cut
videos.overview: Stone arrests and charges Andy Walker as a try-on.

videos.title: Hagger
videos.overview: DS Cecil Haggar is back in Newtown.  He's at a loose end, so he gravitates towards the nearest pub.  There he finds trouble.

videos.title: Playtime
videos.overview: Stone and Skinner are off duty.  Then there's a jewel theft and a robbery with violence.

videos.title: Sweet Girl
videos.overview: A lass is missing...

videos.title: Access
videos.overview: Quilley stops at a pub.  Is it routine, or isn't it?

videos.title: Goss
videos.overview: Mrs. Goss and a lawyer add up to problems for DI Goss.

videos.title: The Wolf And The Sheep Part 1
The Wolf And The Sheep Part 2
videos.overview: Sgt. Miller is back on duty and up against another pro.  He gets some good advice.

videos.title: Forget It Part 2
videos.overview: A man with no name and no memory - or a man with something to hide?

videos.title: A Neighbour's Goods Part 2
videos.overview: There's a dead woman and Sgt. Miller expects trouble.  Then an anonymous phone call brings more surprises for him.

videos.title: Loyalties Part 2
videos.overview: Stolen gear, or planted?  Stone and Lynch disagree.  Lynch is trying to get one over Stone.  Then the punch-up happens.

videos.title: Relative Values Part 2
videos.overview: OAPs are short of cash... and then the police are involved.  Stone and Skinner are looking for something old-fashioned.

videos.title: Not Good Enough Part 2
videos.overview: Sgt. Miller wants him.  So does Skinner.  But Bright is clever.  Miller tries the 'Chinese Water Torture'.

videos.title: Breakage Part 2
videos.overview: A man with a parcel - George T. Wood - who's looking for someone; who's been kept waiting most of his life.  And a derelict building, all glass and wind - and someone up on the roof.  Quilley takes a big risk.

videos.title: Connor
videos.overview: Fred Connor is the new Detective Inspector at Newtown.  He has unfinished business - with a villain named Bright.

videos.title: The Team
videos.overview: Inspector Connor is on trial.  So is Sgt. Stone and the entire Newtown police force.

videos.title: Witness
videos.overview: Terence Nichols is in custody at Newtown police station after a wages snatch.  There are three days to the trial and Stone thinks it's an open and shut case.  He has a reliable witness in Sydney Adams.  But one of the villains is still on the run.

videos.title: Takes All Sorts
videos.overview: A new Inspector arrives at Newtown, Ralph Edward Pratt by name, spruce as a pocket hanky and dripping self-confidence.  He is fussy and believes in doing everything by the book.  He also wants to get involved in everything that's going on, however trivial.  It doesn't take long for Bert Lynch to take a violent dislike to the newcomer and to make every effort to avoid him!

videos.title: Sins Of The Father
videos.overview: Wives of prisoners are easier to chat up than the prisoners themselves - and Inspector Connor wants to find the missing money from a bank robbery.

videos.title: Damage
videos.overview: Night-time and a frightened house breaker.  Newtown police reveal an unusual mystery.

videos.title: Day Trip
videos.overview: Sgt. Haggar and PC Quilley are back on the strength just at the time Dilly Watson, a clever thief, arrives in Newtown.

videos.title: Public Relations
videos.overview: DS Haggar doesn't like Ken Knowles.  ""Journalists,"" he says, ""grow fat on misrepresenting police information"".  He doesn't like old Bertha either.  She doesn't give information.  So what chance does he stand against both of them?

videos.title: Old Soldiers
videos.overview: Old Sepp is passing through Newtown.  PC Hackett is on the way out.  But both are involved with Marlene.

videos.title: Diabolical Liberty
videos.overview: There's just no helping some people, as Bert Lynch finds out when Chief Inspector Logie investigates a break-in with a difference.

videos.title: Old Acquaintance
videos.overview: A newly released prisoner, Dan Fowler, returns to his wife Julia and plans to fix an old enemy.  But Julia has plans of her own.

videos.title: The Legacy
videos.overview: Sgt. Stone goes to the funeral of an old and respected thief in the hope of unearthing a few skeletons.  But dead men don't talk and neither will this one's grandson.

videos.title: The Amateurs
videos.overview: While Austin Nuttall dreams of owning his own business Connor dreams of nailing a fence.  And with two crimes unsolved, Connor demonstrates how to kill two men and two birds with one stone.

videos.title: Hobo
videos.overview: A gullible old man, a con man, and a do-gooder.  And Tom Stone is right in the middle and in need of somewhere to live.

videos.title: Skinner
videos.overview: Skinner returns to C.I.D.  He's after a villain, wanted by both the Met. and DS Haggar.

videos.title: Skin Game
videos.overview: A safe-breaker, a club owner and a farmer.  All three play the same game until Miller joins in and gets under their skin.

videos.title: Backwater
videos.overview: All Tom Stone wants is a quiet weekend's fishing, but then he meets Sergeant Rust.  Together they catch a very queer fish, but have different ideas about landing it.

videos.title: Big Jake
videos.overview: Who gets to Big Jake first, Billy Fielden or DC Skinner?  One of them wants to help him, the other just wants him. And who, or what, is Big Jake anyway?

videos.title: Women At Work
videos.overview: Two working women, one admired by Lynch, the other disliked by Miller.  And in the background a singular third person, badly wanted by Skinner.

videos.title: Jack The Dodger
videos.overview: There's a problem for Skinner when a suspicious odd-job man takes lodgings with an old flame of Bert Lynch.

videos.title: Miller
videos.overview: A body in a canal and Miller follows a chain of enquiries that brings him face to face with... himself.

videos.title: Care
videos.overview: Two girls with their husbands away.  Maureen is the social type and likes a drink; Jill is the lonely type, but she finds something for the police to do.

videos.title: Operation Watchdog
videos.overview: Connor comes back to vandalism and to conflict with some local bigwigs.  And Skinner's in a spot of bother

videos.title: Defection
videos.overview: A member of a visiting Trade Delegation takes a positive step concerning th future.  But Sgt. Stone's future is left for Connor and Richards to fight over.

videos.title: Invention
videos.overview: Rowena Bishop has a reputation for storytelling.  She tells Sgt. Lynch about a body down on the foreshore.

videos.title: Hard Man
videos.overview: Clifford Roscoe is the local hard man.  He's fresh out of jail and ready and anxious to cause trouble.  But Stone and Connor are ready for him.

videos.title: Domestic
videos.overview: A bitter argument, an unexpected tragedy and Sgt. Stone finds himself pushing a suspect very hard indeed.

videos.title: Pat
videos.overview: Pat Mason is a Salvationist and everyone likes her, particularly the regulars at Alan Doherty's pub.  So why should anyone want to hurt her?

videos.title: Bowman
videos.overview: Bringing up a family in Newtown isn't easy, especially for a copper.

videos.title: The Lady And The Gentleman
videos.overview: There's a housebreaker with a difference operating in Newtown.  He leaves no marks when he breaks in and he never steals anything.

videos.title: Suspicion
videos.overview: Sgt. Lynch takes an interest in Susan Rawlings while her husband is in prison.

videos.title: Mileage
videos.overview: Jupp has a large family and needs to keep his job.  But events pile up against him - his boss and a robbery - and he needs to keep his cool.

videos.title: Routine
videos.overview: Lynch and Quilley are on 'nights'.  And a routine call to a break-in leads to a break-up that's far from routine.

videos.title: The Spike
videos.overview: A suspicious death.  Who is and who isn't involved?  And what is the fiddle going on at Munster House?

videos.title: Hi-Jack
videos.overview: A stolen lorry load of meat parked on a busy road.  A piece of cake for the police, unless the lorry driver's name is Houdini!

videos.title: Mother And Child
videos.overview: Joyce is very protective towards her son - even when he's in prison.

videos.title: Co-Operation
videos.overview: Understanding between husband and wife, detective and villain, Police Constable and member of the public - but what about the co-operation between Stone and Haggar?

videos.title: No Proceedings
videos.overview: Hugo Vallance, an old-fashioned Lord of the Manor, is trying to survive in a modern world - of gossip, scandal and theft.

videos.title: Officer Material...?
videos.overview: It's the day of Lynch's promotion board.  He's already passed his exams, so he knows his stuff.  But - is he the right type to be an officer?

videos.title: Inspector Lynch
videos.overview: Bert Lynch has been promoted to Inspector.  But is he still one of the lads?

videos.title: Nuisance
videos.overview: Alexandra is always complaining to an already overworked police force about her next door neighbour Percy.  But is she just a nuisance?  Or should Inspector Lynch take her complaints seriously?

videos.title: Escape
videos.overview: Some London villains spring Charlie Cotton from prison, but, too late, he cottons on to the fact that he's been sprung for a purpose.

videos.title: Break Up
videos.overview: A woman is arrested for shoplifting and a thief has his alibi checked.  On the face of it two routine cases.  But even the most routine cases can have repercussions.

videos.title: Stray Girl
videos.overview: Mary Mangan disappears with her baby.  The worst is feared and a full scale police search is mounted.

videos.title: Pieces
videos.overview: A house is broken into and Skinner grabs at the opportunity to improve his record.  But he grabs too hard and a man suffers.

videos.title: The Cinder Path
videos.overview: Goss is back!  In court he finds himself in an unfamiliar role.  Against Quilley... twice!

videos.title: Cadet
videos.overview: Cadet Peter Preston wants nothing more than to be a policeman, and even though he's a bit of a joke at Newtown his future seems assured.  Then his father takes someone for a ride.

videos.title: Pressure Of Work
videos.overview: Goss goes out for a quiet day with a friend, but the friend ends up in a cell and a policeman ends up in hospital.

videos.title: Absence
videos.overview: A bank raid is in the offing and the only man who knows anything about it is Harry Dance.

videos.title: In Police Hands
videos.overview: Julie and Dave are happy: then they're in the nick.  It seems that simply being in love is a crime these days.

videos.title: Two Hundred Tartan Teddy Bears
videos.overview: Stone and Lynch are puzzled by two cases - one involving bears and the other old ladies.

videos.title: Joanna
videos.overview: When Albert Smith goes looking for his daughter Joanna his enquiries cause trouble.

videos.title: Pressure
videos.overview: A young petty thief and a young Police Constable find themselves under a similar kind of pressure.  The pressure to prove themselves.

videos.title: Waste
videos.overview: Not so much a skeleton in the cupboard - more a body, alive and kicking, in the attic.

videos.title: Two Wise Monkeys
videos.overview: When villains like Burford and Tyndale fall out they will go to any lengths to settle a score.  And somewhere along the line the police have to take drastic measures.

videos.title: Dinner Break
videos.overview: Lunchtime - relaxation for some.  But not for those on duty at Newtown Station.

videos.title: Allegiance
videos.overview: Joe Skinner questions a lad about breaking into a cigarette machine, but it soon becomes apparent that he is after more than a confession.

videos.title: Rota
videos.overview: The same crime can be committed over and over again, unless someone decides to co-operate with the police.

videos.title: Priority
videos.overview: Quilley and Braithwaite have a tricky customer to deal with; Lynch has Stone, as well as a missing child and a shop break-in.

videos.title: Losers
videos.overview: DI Connor runs into Marjorie, an old flame.  But what a change in her!

videos.title: Turnabout
videos.overview: Mary and Fiona, two women of equal ability and opportunity.  So why is one of them a criminal?

videos.title: Mugs?
videos.overview: Several well-planned robberies, but none of the suspects with brains and style enough to organise them.  So who did?

videos.title: Pastime
videos.overview: A fire-raiser for Skinner and an extortionist for Stone and Lynch.  Some people have the strangest pastimes.

videos.title: Certain Parties
videos.overview: Back in Newtown after seven years in Parkhurst, Pikey Nimmo wants to settle up with the men who put him away.  Stone was one of them.

videos.title: Family
videos.overview: Susan Giles wants her father back inside and uses two men to help her.  One of them is Quilley, and he unwittingly ruins Skinner's work.

videos.title: Bits An' Bats
videos.overview: There's a new Cash'n'Carry being built in Newtown and some odd characters work on it.  One of them is on the fiddle - bits and bats to begin with.

videos.title: Old Bones
videos.overview: Lynch deals with a skeleton on the moors and Skinner with several in various cupboards.

videos.title: Mysteries
videos.overview: Ossie Davies is a security guard.  He's a pushover.  You just knock off his specs, threaten him a bit and help yourself.  But Miller reckons there's more to Ossie than that.

videos.title: Night Train
videos.overview: Lynch, Quilley and Braithwaite take a night train to Manchester in search of a murder suspect.

videos.title: Friends
videos.overview: Quilley is a good copper, but as an amateur footballer he has his limitations.  Jesse Alty is a good footballer but has ambitions to be a better car thief.  He and Quilley play for the same team and Gordon Glossop is a friend of both of them.

videos.title: Gardens
videos.overview: A quiet Sunday - and the dead body of a man, smartly dressed, slumped in an allotment shed.

videos.title: Quiet As The Grave
videos.overview: Sunday night duty is traditionally quiet, but on this occasion it's too quiet for Miller's comfort.

videos.title: Pursuit
videos.overview: A call reporting an early morning break-in is quickly answered and Render is only minutes behind the intruder.

videos.title: Have You Seen This Child
videos.overview: Colin Williams haunts Inspector Lynch, and Sergeant Moffatt haunts a thief called Mulligan.

videos.title: Occupation
videos.overview: A factory work-in is on its last legs with the police outside the gates, keeping the peace but waiting for someone to break it.

videos.title: Unnecessary Force
videos.overview: How did a man like Derek Murphy get beaten up by his best friend, a man half his size?  A puzzle for Miller, Yates and Skinner.

videos.title: The Bouncer
videos.overview: Eddy Howarth is the over-enthusiastic bouncer at the local dance hall, but his devotion to duty and jealousy over a woman land him in trouble, and he finds himself facing a serious charge.

videos.title: House To House
videos.overview: A full-scale house to house enquiry fails to produce a witness until a mysterious night prowler and two criminals lay their own freedom on the line.

videos.title: Boy In Blue
videos.overview: The men at Newtown question their own stability when the past catches up with a lady called Gwen Newcombe.

videos.title: Local Knowledge
videos.overview: Lynch receives a tip-off from a friend and finds himself in the middle of a delicate enquiry with his loyalties divided.

videos.title: Innocent And Vulnerable
videos.overview: Tempers fray among men constructing a block of flats, but for one family who actually live in a high-rise, nerves reach breaking point and an everyday flare-up develops into a police enquiry.

videos.title: Intervention
videos.overview: Just two miles from Newtown centre lies open country and another world where people settle their grievances in a different way.

videos.title: Transit
videos.overview: When a lock-keeper complains of strange noises coming from a disused warehouse, a routine enquiry turns into a macabre situation.

videos.title: Snouts
videos.overview: Jack Melish is walking down a deserted street near the docks to keep a secret appointment with Inspector Lynch.  Suddenly a car pulls up alongside him and he is bundled into the back seat.  The car races off...

videos.title: Eviction
videos.overview: Continuation of the previous episode 'Squatters'.  With Quilley in hospital, Lynch's attitude to the squatters hardens.

videos.title: Incitement
videos.overview: Why should a woman want to betray her husband to the police - even before he has committed the crime?

videos.title: Thanks But...No Thanks
videos.overview: Alec Quilley is up for promotion.  He has an excellent service record, but how close an examination will his private life bear?

videos.title: Kronur
videos.overview: A fool and his money are soon parted - all the sooner if you don't know how much the money is worth.

videos.title: Scapegoat
videos.overview: As an act of kindness Bert Lynch gives a deadbeat tramp a cell for the night - and finds himself up to his neck in trouble.

videos.title: Bit Of Business
videos.overview: A casual enquiry about car thieves leads Skinner to suspect that someone is taking him for a ride.

videos.title: Distance
videos.overview: Joe Skinner fancies a bird.  She seems to fancy him.  So why is he investigating her background?

videos.title: Ritual
videos.overview: Continuation of the previous episode 'Distance'.  Skinner has been shot dead and the Murder Squad have taken over the case.  So why is Haggar meeting a mate halfway down the M6?

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: Continuation of the two previous episodes 'Distance' and 'Ritual'.  The hunt for Skinner's murderer has moved away from Newtown.  So why is a London detective on his way there, in secret?

videos.title: A New Broom
videos.overview: The new CID Inspector is an old mate of Cecil Haggar's... isn't he?

videos.title: Guns
videos.overview: Armed robbery is becoming almost a daily event and sooner or later somebody's bound to get hurt.  But what happens if the police meet violence with violence?

videos.title: Manslaughter
videos.overview: The public expect to be protected by the police.  But if a policeman kills a member of the public in the execution of his duty, will the protector be prosecuted?

videos.title: Prisoner
videos.overview: When a constable is ten minutes late reporting in an alert goes out.  Alec Quilley hasn't been seen or heard of for over an hour.

videos.title: The Frighteners
videos.overview: An ex-villain is entitled to police protection just like anyone else - isn't he?

videos.title: Contact
videos.overview: A man is trapped under a load of dangerous chemicals.  Move him, and the lot might go up.  Leave him there and...

videos.title: Kidnap
videos.overview: A rag week kidnap for charity starts out all right, but...

videos.title: Say Goodbye To The Horses
videos.overview: There are plenty of ways to make sure a horse loses a race, but how do you make a horse WIN a race?

videos.title: A Preacher In Passing
videos.overview: A quiet Sunday and Moffat finds himself in church.  But not praying!

videos.title: Nightwatch
videos.overview: Keeping surveillance on a goods yard full of empty wagons seems a pretty barren exercise - unless you know what's at stake.

videos.title: Ringers
videos.overview: In detection you need routine and instinct.  But not necessarily in that order.

videos.title: Fairground
videos.overview: A young girl is attacked and Lynch has to look into 'all the fun of the fair'.

videos.title: Hunch
videos.overview: Which is more important - a batch of missing cameras, or a missing girl?

videos.title: Scot Free
videos.overview: Two boys are trapped in a disused mine.  Why is their friend terrified of going to the police?

videos.title: Transit
videos.overview: A mystery call out for noise down the docks perplexes Yates, and he's stuck there with DS Haggar and an irritating PC. They shoot horses, don't they?

videos.title: Snouts
videos.overview: A police informer is found badly beaten on a rubbish tip, whilst Bert Lych waits for him in a local pub. Who was responsible, and what is the connection to a rough local pub?

videos.title: Thanks But... No Thanks
videos.overview: Quilley is up for promotion, but personal circumstances may hinder his path. At the same time, a troublesome thief is causing him severe problems.

videos.title: A New Broom
videos.overview: A series of break-ins have some peculiar traits. Haggar thinks that an old lag just out of gaol may be responsible. But what is the significance of a missing schoolboy, and why is the MO of the mystery criminal familiar?

videos.title: The Man Who Killed Songbirds
videos.overview: Young Colin's route home from school lies across a grubby parkland.  Hiding in the bushes is a man with sweets... and a knife.

videos.title: Rage
videos.overview: It's not like Arthur Scarsdale to be violent.  He's normally a peaceful little villain, but in the Newtown nick it takes three policemen to hold him down - and all Bowker did was offer him a cup of tea.

videos.title: Guilt
videos.overview: Quilley was at school with Chris Murray and knows he wouldn't hurt a soul.  So when Chris half murders a man and pleads guilty Quilley wants to know why.

videos.title: Transit
videos.overview: Crime Squad from Cardiff want Inspector Moffat to lodge a prisoner overnight in the Newtown cells - and no-one must know about it.  But someone has to know, even if it's only another policeman.

videos.title: Error Of Judgement
videos.overview: Lorry hi-jacks: too many, too well-planned and executed.  Braithwaite goes 'under cover' as a lorry driver with a shady past.  He's out in the cold - and vulnerable.

videos.title: Scavengers
videos.overview: Digging a deep hole in the sand by the light of the moon isn't the sort of behaviour you'd expect from a debt collector.  Not even such a strange one as Clarrie Enwright.

videos.title: Fall Of Wiskers Castle
videos.overview: It's his first day as a sergeant and Alec Quilley's hung over.  It's his first job as a sergeant, and it requires a bit of gentle persuasion.  But how can you be gently persuasive to a double-barrelled sawn-off shotgun?

videos.title: Rip Off
videos.overview: DC Bowker and Jack Crawford have met before.  Their relationship is very simple: one way or another Bowker is going to nail Crawford, unless Crawford can nail Bowker first.

videos.title: Attack
videos.overview: Coppers are fair game and copper-baiting is a good sport - unless the copper you pick on happens to be an expert in unarmed combat.  In that case the game's called mayhem.

videos.title: Skeletons
videos.overview: Excavating for a swimming pool a young couple come across an old trunk buried in their garden.  For the police it means old files, old memories and old wounds must all be re-opened.

videos.title: Domestic
videos.overview: Unlike his brother Terry, who's just a flat-footed scuffer, Graham Moffat is all set to wheeler-dealer his way into big business.  Trouble is - the way it looks to Terry - brother Graham is all set to wheeler-dealer his way into crime.

videos.title: Heavenly Host
videos.overview: Shabnam Chowdry is a young Asian girl.  Roy Grant is a young white boy.  Put them together and knives are drawn - and Lynch is in the middle.

videos.title: Debris
videos.overview: Newtown Marriage Guidance Centre has been burned down, so Haggar and Bowker start investigating its clients.  They are looking for a man or woman with a grudge - a man or woman who will strike again.

videos.title: Quilley On The Spot
videos.overview: A policeman can only take so much.  Lynch deals with the problem one way, Quilley another.  Trouble is, in Quilley's case there's a woman involved.

videos.title: A Woman's Place
videos.overview: Night duty in Newtown is a rough turn; not the place for a young policewoman.  But WPC Jane Beck won't listen to the warnings of Inspector Lynch.

videos.title: Exposure
videos.overview: Roger Stevens is the quiet sort of copper, always there.  Perhaps that's why Lynch tends to take him for granted.  But sometimes it's the quiet kind one needs to worry about most of all.

videos.title: Fat Freddie BA
videos.overview: Freddie Cowling has come out of prison a changed man.  He's lost a lot of weight, he's got a degree and he's promised his wife he'll go straight from now on.  But Lynch doesn't believe he's changed.  Not when there's the proceeds of his last job to be collected - £40,000 hidden away and waiting...

videos.title: First Offender
videos.overview: Sunday - kids who have nothing to do.  First Lynch, then Haggar gets involved - they do have something to do.

videos.title: Deserter
videos.overview: Frank Rafael Saietta has come home to Newtown.  Lynch remembers him as a nice little lad, but that was years ago.  Now there are different words to describe him - terrorist and murderer.

videos.title: Rummage
videos.overview: Lynch holds the balance between C.I.D. and the Customs & Excise as they investigate a bent businessman and a suspicious German ship.  The only link between them is a showgirl.

videos.title: Prey
videos.overview: Maureen Price was always complaining to the police - so much so that they'd stopped listening.  The pity is that if they hadn't she might be alive today.

videos.title: Departures
videos.overview: Two men face retirement, one a policeman, the other a villain.  There are younger men impatient to fill their shoes.  The copper has no choice about it, but the villain has other ideas.

videos.title: Pressure
videos.overview: A new security shutter is being installed at the entrance to Newtown station, just in time, it seems, as an angry mob gathers outside.  A stream of visitors keeps the desk duty officer busy.
